body:
Track 5 follow-up to `simdesign-widerweb`: closed-form lateral-torsional buckling safety factors for the bracket arms, replacing the arbitrary w/b slenderness limit as a reasoning basis. Stylised, preliminary, not FE-validated. At the 2 mm gauge the factor is 6.9–9.0 for w = 16–20 mm; it rises with w, opposite to the w/b ceiling; at 1 mm the old rule admits designs below 1. The two textbook coefficients (π/2, 4.013) are verified numerically in the tests; page-level book references are unchecked and flagged in the README.

Checks: 4 tests pass, `python site/build.py` prints ok.
